prompt: After upgrading from an older app version, some user settings are lost. Existing settings should migrate forward without dropping fields the frontend still needs.
issue_title: User settings sometimes reset after upgrading from an older version
issue_body: After upgrading from an older app version, some user settings are lost. Existing settings should migrate forward without dropping fields the frontend still needs.
expected_behavior: Version 1 settings migrate to the current version.
Fields not known to the migration are preserved.
A settings document already at the current version is left unchanged.
Optional fields that are absent receive their default.
expected_failure_summary: Two coupled defects in migrate(): it rebuilds a fresh map containing only version, theme and vault_root and returns it for every document with no early return for an already-current document (discarding every unknown field on a v1 migration and rewriting an already-current document so it is no longer byte-equal); and theme derivation ignores darkMode, always defaulting an absent theme to "light" instead of deriving "dark" from darkMode==true.
task_author_notes: Migrate in place on the existing map: derive theme from darkMode (dark when darkMode==true) only when theme is absent, drop the legacy darkMode key, ensure vault_root, set version, and keep every other key. Return an already-current document unchanged.
